name: Golm Fragment
summary: At the southern Wetlands dig, Golm Fragment lies among the four missing pieces of the Goaz Stone. Dwarven archaeologists need it to piece together the ancient Titan inscriptions.

sections.title: A Piece of the Goaz Stone
sections.body: Golm Fragment lies among the remains of Whelgar's excavation in the southern Wetlands. Prospector Whelgar found the monumental Goaz Stone shortly before raptors drove the Explorers' League back. Its inscription had been severed in four places. When the dig was overrun, the fragment remained amid dirt and overturned crates, hidden inside an ancient relic box until explorers could retrieve it.

sections.title: Secrets of the Titans
sections.body: Golm Fragment completes a cryptic Titan text when joined with the Ados, Modr, and Neru fragments. Reassembling the Goaz Stone lets Whelgar decipher lines about a divine plan, a doomed prophecy, and ancient entities chained beneath the earth. The inscription reveals lore older and more dangerous than dwarven heritage alone.

faq.q: What is the Golm Fragment used for?
faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar needs Golm Fragment with three other pieces to restore the Goaz Stone at the Wetlands excavation site during Uncovering the Past.

faq.q: Where can the Golm Fragment be found?
faq.answer: Golm Fragment can be found in ancient relics and loose soil across the raptor-infested dig site in the southern Wetlands hills.

faq.q: What does the Goaz Stone say once assembled?
faq.answer: Whelgar's first translation speaks of a divine plan and a doomed prophecy. He needs all four fragments to keep deciphering the incomplete Titan script.

faq.q: What other fragments are needed to finish the stone?
faq.answer: You need the Ados, Modr, and Neru fragments along with Golm to assemble the tablet.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can help piece together the Goaz Stone and uncover your Titan ancestry and the hidden history beneath Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance member, you help the Explorers' League secure priceless ancient knowledge before raptors overrun the dig site.
